# Blurs that used to recurse until the stack overflowed: the image is only a few pixels across (or one axis is) compared with sigma.
# image size | call | edge
1x1        | GaussianBlur(50)            | any
1x400      | GaussianBlur(40)            | any
3x10000    | GaussianBlur(200)           | any
10000x3    | GaussianBlur(1e6)           | any
2x2        | BoxBlur(4096)               | any
3x3        | BoxBlur(200)                | any
5x5        | Sharpen(radius: 1000)       | any
1x1        | Sharpen(radius: 1e300)      | any
